register.labelZh: DISH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dish out 可以描述派發卡片、地圖、食物、藥物及其他物品。；dish up 可以簡潔自然地表示把煮好的食物分到碟或碗裏。；dish up 可以表示表演者、作者或講者再次搬出同一批陳舊內容。；同一個表達既可以描述上菜,也可以描述反覆搬出舊笑話、故事和藉口。
register.summaryEn: Dish out can describe giving out cards, maps, food, medicine and other items. Dish up gives you a short, natural way to describe putting cooked food onto plates or into bowls. Dish up can show that a performer, writer or speaker is offering the same old material again. The same expression can describe serving a meal or repeatedly offering old jokes, stories and excuses.
